design.hero_pattern: A bold headline with context-setting subheading followed by explanatory body text and supporting details.
design.chart_placement: Market data sits at top in tabular format; featured stories include embedded images placed above or alongside text blocks.
design.typography: Clean sans-serif with strong weight hierarchy; large bold section headlines contrasting against smaller body text and labels.
takeaways: Lead with high-impact stat or market snapshot in tabular format before diving into narrative stories
Pair each major story with a single supporting image and keep text scannable with subheadings and bold callouts
Integrate native sponsored content as full story blocks rather than sidebars, maintaining visual consistency with editorial content
Conclude with lightweight engagement (polls, trivia, recommendations) to reduce cognitive load and encourage interaction

design.hero_pattern: Single lead statistic paired with a brief headline and accompanying image (e.g., '1 in 5 Financial Advice Seekers Are Turning to AI').
design.chart_placement: No charts visible; articles use thumbnail photography placed left of headline/summary text in card layout.
design.cta_text: Subscribe / Get more than news. Get insights.
design.cta_position: Prominent header bar and repeated throughout footer
design.typography: Sans-serif, moderate weight, clear hierarchy with larger headlines (18-24px) and smaller body text (14-16px) for scanability.
takeaways: Lead story pattern: headline + 1-2 sentence summary + read time + photo creates rapid scanability and encourages clicks
Grid layout with category tags above headlines enables both browsing and topic-focused reading
Consistent card design (photo + category label + headline + summary + read time) provides predictable information architecture across 15+ articles
Multiple CTA placements ('Subscribe', 'Get insights') in header and footer with emphasis on free value proposition builds newsletter conversions

design.hero_pattern: Bold headline introducing downloadable housing market data followed by a single call-to-action button.
design.chart_placement: Charts and data products are presented as individual card/module entries below descriptive text.
design.typography: Clean sans-serif with moderate weight contrast between headers and body text; hierarchical sizing from hero to product descriptions.
takeaways: Grid-based product card layout with consistent update cadence shown for each dataset (weekly/monthly/quarterly)
Modular product cards with title, description, and update frequency stacked vertically for easy scanning
Extensive regional and category link structure in footer supports SEO and navigation discovery pathways
Hero section uses directional language ('Explore', 'Download') with minimal friction to primary action
